description: Baseline Electron knowledge base with minimal harness

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a BrowserWindow with correct dimensions and preload script
features.evidence: Visible launch smoke test on 2026-05-25 observed an Electron process with MainWindowTitle 'Knowledge Base'; src/main/main.ts configures 1200x800 with contextIsolation=true and nodeIntegration=false.

features.name: Document List Panel
features.description: Left sidebar shows imported documents with empty state message
features.evidence: src/renderer/components/DocumentList.tsx renders empty-state text and metadata cards populated through the typed documents.list IPC bridge; npm run check passes.

features.name: Question Panel
features.description: Bottom input bar accepts questions and submits via IPC
features.evidence: QuestionPanel submits questions through window.knowledgeBase.qa.ask; tests/knowledge-base.test.ts verifies an answer returns a document chunk citation and persists history.

features.name: Data Directory
features.description: PersistenceService creates and manages userData/knowledge-base-data directory
features.evidence: PersistenceService creates data/documents/index directories and performs atomic JSON writes; lifecycle tests exercise persisted content, chunks, manifest, and Q&A history.

features.name: Document Management
features.description: Users import supported local documents, inspect metadata, and delete associated stored data
features.evidence: Native import dialog accepts .txt/.md files; DocumentService enforces extension and 10 MB constraints, copies content with unique names, and deletes content/chunks/index metadata. Covered by tests/knowledge-base.test.ts.

features.name: Text Indexing
features.description: Documents are split into paragraph-aware chunks and can be indexed individually or as a library
features.evidence: IndexingService persists index/index-meta.json and per-document chunks with charCount/wordCount metadata; UI provides Index Document and Index All Documents controls; lifecycle test confirms indexed chunks.

features.name: Grounded Q&A
features.description: Questions return local answers with chunk citations, confidence scoring, and persisted history
features.evidence: QaService ranks stored chunks and returns 0.85 confidence with citations while App renders answer history; lifecycle test verifies citation title, confidence, and persisted history.

features.name: Latest Answer Citation Count
features.description: The interface displays the number of citations associated with the most recent answer
features.evidence: LatestCitationCount derives the count from the final Q&A history entry and is rendered in App above answer history; tests/latest-citation-count.test.ts verifies that only the latest answer's count is displayed and that no count appears before an answer exists. npm.cmd run check, npm.cmd test (4 tests), and npm.cmd run build passed; an Electron smoke launch displayed the Knowledge Base window.

features.name: Status Bar
features.description: The UI displays overall index status, document count, and last activity time
features.evidence: GET_STATUS IPC handler returns IndexingService.getAppStatus(); App refreshes the typed status and StatusBar displays index state, document count, activity time, and working indicator.
